articles.title: The Telo MT1 is a big truck trapped in a tiny truck’s body
articles.description: I'm bouncing down the road in San Carlos, California, zipping past behemoth tech companies like EA and Oracle, in America's smallest electric truck. The Telo MT1 (which stands for "mini truck") unquestionably turns heads because it looks so remarkably different from everything else on the market right now. articles.title: The director of Fjord takes the 'risky position' of moderator
articles.description: Cristian Mungiu's sixth feature, Fjord, concerns a family on trial. They seem like good people, God-fearing.
